acceptanceCriteria: A protocol fixture must exercise valid, unknown, duplicate, and expired invitations; unknown inviter or disabled policy sends no acceptance packet. Keep sanitized event assertions.

features.title: Experience sharing
features.description: Experience-sharing mode is displayed from server-confirmed party state and is not inferred from a configuration request.
acceptanceCriteria: Party response fixtures must decode each supported sharing mode and reject unknown mode values without changing current membership state. Keep packet fixture.

features.title: Item sharing
features.description: Item-sharing rules are represented from server-confirmed party settings and never cause a local item transfer assumption.
acceptanceCriteria: A party settings fixture must decode supported distribution modes; unknown or unsupported modes display unavailable and do not change inventory. Preserve decoder assertions.

features.title: Follow
features.description: Follow movement tracks the selected party actor's confirmed position and replans when that actor moves or disappears; it never treats intended leader coordinates as reached.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic leader movement stream must produce safe following steps and stop on actor loss, map mismatch, or no route. Keep leader/route timeline.

features.title: Group support
features.description: Group support selects only eligible current members and coordinates healing/buffs from confirmed status, respecting skill conditions and cooldowns.
acceptanceCriteria: A multi-member status fixture must choose the expected target and suppress duplicate support; stale membership, missing status, or denied cast must not mark the member supported. Preserve decision and response trace.

features.title: Guilds
features.description: Guild membership and guild events are scoped to the server-confirmed guild identity and are cleared or updated on authoritative membership events.
acceptanceCriteria: Golden packet fixtures must cover join/leave and relevant identity fields; stale guild data after leaving must not drive group actions. Keep state snapshots.

features.title: Clans
features.description: Clan entities are parsed only when the active server profile provides clan-specific packet semantics, remaining separate from guild state.
acceptanceCriteria: A supported-profile fixture must decode one clan membership/update and ensure it cannot overwrite guild identity; unsupported profiles keep clan data unavailable. Preserve profile fixture.

features.title: Friends
features.description: Friend records update from server responses and identify the associated account/character without confusing a friend entry with a currently visible actor.
acceptanceCriteria: A fixture must test online/offline and removal events; unknown IDs remain unlinked and do not create actor records. Keep decoded list and actor map assertions.

features.title: Chat rooms
features.description: Chat-room state reflects server-confirmed room membership, title, and participant updates; joining or leaving is not assumed from a request alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Protocol fixtures must test create/join/leave and participant updates with one rejection path; stale room IDs cannot retain membership. Preserve sanitized transcript.

features.title: Guild skills
features.description: Guild skill use requires confirmed guild membership, the required skill state, and server-permitted target/context.
acceptanceCriteria: Skill and guild fixtures must assert request gating and server-confirmed effect; nonmember, cooldown, or denial prevents success. Keep rule and response evidence.

features.title: Alliances
features.description: Alliance relationships are represented from server events with source guild identity and relationship status; unknown updates do not establish trusted links.
acceptanceCriteria: A protocol fixture must add/change/remove one alliance and preserve unrelated guilds; unknown IDs remain explicitly unresolved. Keep event snapshot.

features.title: Pet detection
features.description: A pet actor is created and removed from server-reported pet identity and status packets, separate from ordinary monsters and players.
acceptanceCriteria: Pet lifecycle packet fixtures must create, update, and remove one pet without type confusion; unknown data remains an unknown actor. Preserve decoded events and snapshot.

features.title: Pet following
features.description: Pet following status reflects server-observed pet position/status and does not issue movement commands on behalf of an unconfirmed pet state.
acceptanceCriteria: Actor movement fixtures must update only the pet record and clear stale following state on removal; keep state snapshots.

features.title: Pet feeding
features.description: Feeding is requested only when the pet and a compatible food item are present and the server profile supports the feed exchange; intimacy/status changes require a reply.
acceptanceCriteria: An authorized protocol fixture must test accepted/denied feed and reconcile item count/status; missing food or unsupported profile sends no request. Keep redacted trace.

features.title: Pet capture
features.description: Capture attempts require an eligible target and supported capture item/skill, and success is recorded only after server-confirmed capture state.
acceptanceCriteria: A profile fixture must distinguish accepted, failed, and timed-out capture; failure leaves target/item state unchanged unless server confirms consumption. Preserve sanitized response.

features.title: Pet evolution
features.description: Evolution is offered only when server-reported companion level/items/requirements satisfy the selected evolution rule and is finalized from a server response.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic prerequisite fixture must reject unmet requirements; authorized protocol response must reconcile identity/status changes and failure. Keep requirement matrix and redacted trace.

features.title: Homunculi
features.description: Homunculus identity, stats, skills, and lifecycle events are maintained as a distinct server-owned companion entity.
acceptanceCriteria: Golden packet fixtures must update a homunculus without mutating player stats; missing or unknown status remains explicitly unavailable. Preserve packet-to-state assertions.

features.title: Mercenaries
features.description: Mercenary records track server-reported lifetime, status, and actions and expire only on server event or confirmed timer semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Clocked protocol fixtures must test lifetime boundary and explicit dismissal; local time alone cannot claim dismissal if server state remains active. Keep event timeline.

features.title: Elementals
features.description: Elemental entities use profile-specific identifiers and status fields, remaining distinct from pets, homunculi, and ordinary actors.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported-profile fixtures must decode elemental spawn/status/removal; unknown profile packet must not classify an actor as elemental. Preserve profile matrix.

features.title: Companion AI
features.description: Companion commands are selected from supported companion state and configured rules, with actions gated by the companion's confirmed resources and status.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic companion-state simulation must choose the specified legal command and stop after dismissal/disconnect; unauthorized or stale actor state yields no action. Keep decision trace.

features.title: Automatic arrow crafting
features.description: Arrow crafting selects a configured supported conversion from available materials and weapon/skill state and reconciles the produced quantity from the server response.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic recipe/inventory fixture must calculate exact material use and expected arrows; insufficient materials or server failure cannot decrement inventory locally. Preserve recipe and response trace.

features.title: Item crafting
features.description: An item recipe is executable only when its inputs, quantities, and server-supported crafting action are defined; output is accepted from a confirmed response.
acceptanceCriteria: Recipe fixtures must assert exact inputs and resulting output on success; missing inputs, unknown recipe, and server rejection remain non-success states. Keep recipe version and inventory diff.

features.title: Potion crafting
features.description: Potion crafting uses only a configured supported formula and sufficient ingredients/skill state, with crafted quantity confirmed by server inventory updates.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic input fixture must compute the allowed batch and reconcile success/partial/failure; unknown formulas are not inferred. Preserve formula test and response.

features.title: Poison crafting
features.description: Poison creation validates the required recipe, materials, and skill before transmission and records poison only after server confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Recipe/skill tests must cover valid and missing prerequisites plus server refusal; resulting inventory must match the server update. Keep fixture and inventory snapshots.

features.title: Cooking
features.description: Cooking actions use a declared recipe, current ingredients, and supported server context; the resulting item/status is based on the server's response.
acceptanceCriteria: A recipe fixture must compute item use and expected output; unsupported recipe, missing inputs, or interruption produces a clear incomplete result. Preserve recipe and sanitized event trace.

features.title: Production systems
features.description: A production workflow composes only explicitly registered recipes and server-confirmed steps, and stops when a dependency fails.
acceptanceCriteria: A multi-step deterministic fixture must assert input handoff and stop-on-failure, with final inventory reconciled to server responses. Keep workflow trace.

features.title: Special item options
features.description: Special item options are parsed from supported option identifiers and values without assigning semantics to unknown options.
acceptanceCriteria: Golden option fixtures must decode known options and preserve unknown raw values; malformed encodings fail the item update without corrupting other inventory. Keep decoder fixtures.

features.title: Configuration reading
features.description: The configuration reader loads documented key/value settings with their defaults and typed values, reporting the filename and key for malformed or unknown values without silently coercing them.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture tests must parse representative valid settings and reject malformed types/duplicate invalid values; compare the resulting typed settings with expected values. Keep source fixture and diagnostics.

features.title: Table data reading
features.description: Table readers preserve the declared delimiter, encoding, comment, and column semantics for each supported OpenKore table format.
acceptanceCriteria: Golden table fixtures must parse exact rows and handle comments/blank lines; malformed columns or encoding return line-numbered errors without partial table replacement. Preserve fixture hashes and row assertions.

features.title: Field data reading
features.description: Field data parsing validates dimensions and cell encoding and produces the exact walkability grid used by routing.
acceptanceCriteria: A miniature field fixture must assert dimensions and selected cells; truncated data, mismatched dimensions, and invalid symbols fail with location context. Keep fixture and parse output.

features.title: Timeout configuration
features.description: Named timeout settings parse as finite nonnegative durations and are consumed by their corresponding task without confusing seconds and milliseconds.
acceptanceCriteria: Boundary tests must parse valid zero/positive values and reject negative, non-finite, and malformed values; task fixtures must expire at the configured duration. Preserve config and fake-clock assertions.

features.title: Combat parameters
features.description: Combat settings map each supported target/skill/range parameter to a validated typed rule and preserve explicit defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Representative config fixtures must yield exact decisions for two contrasting combat setups; unknown parameter names or invalid ranges produce diagnostics and do not alter active rules. Keep fixture and decision output.

features.title: Navigation parameters
features.description: Navigation settings such as route, lock map, map-change, and retry options are validated and applied only to the corresponding planner behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Config/field tests must assert one option changes only its documented route rule and invalid coordinate/map values are rejected before movement. Preserve fixture and route result.

features.title: Item parameters
features.description: Item filters, protected lists, pickup limits, and weights are parsed into distinct rules used by inventory and loot decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Table-driven item fixtures must prove inclusion, exclusion, and weight behavior; duplicate/conflicting rules follow the documented precedence or fail validation. Keep config and decision matrix.

features.title: Skill parameters
features.description: Skill blocks parse skill identity, target, level, timing, and condition fields into a validated rule without dropping unsupported fields silently.
acceptanceCriteria: Compatibility fixtures must map each supported field to the expected cast decision and report unsupported/malformed fields by name; no request is emitted on parse error. Preserve source-format fixtures.

features.title: Conditional blocks
features.description: A conditional block associates its predicate with the intended setting/action and evaluates it from one consistent runtime snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser/evaluator tests must prove true and false branches and reject malformed nesting, unknown identifiers, and missing values before side effects. Keep fixture and decision output.

features.title: Dynamic configuration changes
features.description: Runtime changes become visible at a defined task boundary and cannot leave one decision using a mixture of old and new dependent values.
acceptanceCriteria: A controlled task test must change a setting during a queued action and assert the documented snapshot boundary; invalid update leaves the old snapshot active. Preserve state diff.

features.title: Configuration reload
features.description: Reload parses a complete new configuration before replacing active settings; a failed reload retains the last known-good configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture tests must assert successful atomic replacement and malformed-file rollback, including no partially applied values. Keep before/after snapshots and parser errors.

features.title: Configuration persistence
features.description: Persisted changes are written in the compatible format with stable keys and are read back to the same typed values on restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Round-trip tests must preserve comments/unsupported entries according to policy and reproduce values; failed write leaves prior file intact and reports the path. Preserve fixture and round-trip diff.

features.title: Advanced formats
features.description: Advanced supported configuration constructs retain their documented quoting, escaping, multiline, and include semantics without executing arbitrary content.
acceptanceCriteria: Golden fixtures must test supported constructs and reject unsafe/unsupported syntax with file/line diagnostics; include cycles are bounded. Keep fixtures and parser output.

features.title: Extension configuration
features.description: Extension settings are namespaced to the owning extension and validated against its declared options before plugin initialization.
acceptanceCriteria: Two plugin config fixtures must remain isolated; unknown plugin or invalid option prevents that extension from starting without corrupting core configuration. Preserve init result and diagnostics.

features.title: Aliases
features.description: Command aliases expand only at command boundaries using the configured arguments and do not recursively rewrite quoted text or unrelated message content.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser tests must assert exact expansion, argument preservation, and cycle rejection; unmatched input is passed through unchanged. Keep alias fixtures.

features.title: Profiles
features.description: A named profile provides an isolated overlay with explicit precedence over shared configuration and can be switched without stale values leaking between profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Round-trip tests across two profiles must assert only declared overrides differ and returning restores original effective settings; invalid profile preserves active config. Keep snapshots.

features.title: Macro
features.description: Macro files parse supported triggers, delays, labels, and commands into a bounded execution plan; malformed blocks do not run partial commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser and fake-clock fixtures must execute a declared macro in exact order and cancel it on malformed syntax, timeout, or stop; preserve macro file and action trace.

features.title: Composite commands
features.description: A composite command expands into registered commands with their arguments and stops at the first failed prerequisite or explicit cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: A command-sequence fixture must assert exact command order and propagation; unknown command and invalid arguments produce diagnostics without running later steps. Keep parsed plan and trace.

features.title: Declarative automations
features.description: Declarative routines validate their trigger, conditions, and action references before execution and run only from a current event snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema/evaluator fixtures must accept a valid routine and reject unknown actions/fields; simulation must show false conditions emit no action and failure terminates dependents. Preserve routine fixture and result.

features.title: EventMacro
features.description: EventMacro triggers only on matching supported events and evaluates its declared conditions before scheduling commands.
acceptanceCriteria: A synthetic event stream must trigger exactly matching blocks once and ignore unrelated/duplicate events; malformed block and cancelled task produce no delayed command. Keep event trace.

features.title: Conditions
features.description: Script conditions parse into a bounded expression tree and evaluate deterministically against typed values; unknown functions or incompatible operands fail explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Table-driven parser/evaluator tests must assert true/false/error for supported comparisons and reject unsupported operators without executing actions. Preserve expression fixtures.

features.title: Variables
features.description: Script variables have declared scope and lifetime, retain typed values across the specified blocks, and do not leak between independent sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: A multi-script test must assert local/global lifetime and session isolation; undefined or incompatible assignment returns a diagnostic rather than a fabricated value. Keep state snapshots.

features.title: Functions
features.description: Callable script functions validate argument count/types and return a defined result or error to the caller.
acceptanceCriteria: Function fixtures must assert successful return, wrong-argument errors, and nested failure propagation; recursion/step limits stop runaway execution. Preserve test program and trace.

features.title: Hooks
features.description: Extension hooks run only for registered event names and in documented order, and one failing hook cannot corrupt core event dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin fixtures must assert registration/order and isolated failure handling; unregistering a plugin prevents later callbacks. Keep hook trace.

features.title: Extension API
features.description: The extension API exposes documented typed events and commands with lifecycle-scoped registration and explicit errors for unsupported operations.
acceptanceCriteria: A minimal test extension must register, receive one event, unregister, and fail predictably on an unsupported call; preserve API fixture and lifecycle output.

features.title: CLI
features.description: The CLI starts with the selected configuration, reports initialization errors, and returns a nonzero process status when startup cannot establish required state.
acceptanceCriteria: Command-line integration tests must verify valid startup and missing/invalid config exit behavior, including stable machine-readable status where defined. Keep captured output and exit assertions.

features.title: Help
features.description: Help output lists each supported command with its accepted arguments and identifies unknown commands without executing them.
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot tests must compare representative help entries to the registered command table and ensure unknown command input returns help/error only. Preserve snapshot.

features.title: Basic commands
features.description: Basic control commands parse their documented arguments and return a clear success or usage error without sending unrelated protocol actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Table-driven command tests must exercise one valid form and invalid/missing arguments for each exposed basic command; keep command registry and result snapshot.

features.title: Character status view
features.description: The status view renders only the current server-confirmed character values and labels unknown fields as unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a fixed character-state snapshot, output must contain exact HP/SP/level/position and omit stale values after disconnect; preserve expected text snapshot.

features.title: Actor lists
features.description: Actor lists distinguish actor types, show stable identities, and remove entities only when current state says they disappeared.
acceptanceCriteria: A fixed world snapshot must render each entity once with correct type and no removed/stale actor; keep snapshot fixture and output.

features.title: Inventory view
features.description: Inventory output shows current item counts, equipment slots, and unknown metadata without inventing item names or quantities.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic inventory fixture must match expected rows and update after a server delta; malformed item state produces a visible unavailable/error marker. Preserve output snapshot.

features.title: Logs
features.description: Logs include event time, severity, and relevant task/session context while redacting credentials, one-time codes, and sensitive message payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: A logger test must format representative events and scan output for known secret markers; severity filtering must include/exclude the expected events. Keep sanitized output fixture.

features.title: Control commands
features.description: Control commands pause, resume, stop, or change mode through the shared scheduler and report the resulting state transition.
acceptanceCriteria: Command-state tests must prove each allowed transition and reject commands not valid in the current state; stopping prevents later queued actions. Preserve command and event trace.

features.title: Experience reports
features.description: Experience reports derive rates and deltas from timestamped server-confirmed experience samples and show insufficient-data state instead of a fabricated rate.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixed samples with known intervals must yield exact deltas/rate; duplicate timestamps, level reset, and empty history must be handled explicitly. Keep input and report snapshot.

features.title: Damage reports
features.description: Damage reports aggregate decoded damage events by the declared source/target and exclude duplicate or unconfirmed events.
acceptanceCriteria: A fixture with known event IDs and amounts must yield exact totals and ignore duplicates; missing attribution is grouped as unknown, not assigned arbitrarily. Preserve event fixture and output.

features.title: Item reports
features.description: Item reports distinguish acquired, consumed, sold, stored, and unknown deltas based on authoritative inventory/transaction events.
acceptanceCriteria: A transaction stream must reconcile exact per-category counts; an unexplained inventory difference remains unknown rather than counted as loot. Keep stream and report assertions.

features.title: Statistics
features.description: Session statistics use documented event counters and reset boundaries, distinguishing current session from persisted totals.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic event sequence must yield exact counters before and after reset/disconnect; repeated events follow idempotency rules. Preserve counter snapshot.

features.title: Interactive configuration
features.description: Interactive configuration displays the current typed value, validates user input before applying it, and reports write/reload errors without losing the previous value.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI tests must cover valid change, invalid range, cancel, and persistence failure; active setting remains unchanged on failure. Keep input/output capture.

features.title: Graphical interface
features.description: The optional GUI, if enabled for the milestone, exposes session controls and status through the same public state/actions as the CLI and does not own protocol state.
acceptanceCriteria: A headless UI contract test must verify controls invoke shared commands and status updates from fixture events; no GUI availability is reported until an actual supported implementation passes. Keep platform test evidence.

features.title: Visual map
features.description: The map view plots actors and the local character at server-confirmed coordinates in the active field and marks unknown/out-of-bounds positions distinctly.
acceptanceCriteria: A field/world fixture must render exact entity coordinates and clear the map on field change; missing field or invalid location must not place actors at an arbitrary cell. Preserve render snapshot.

features.title: Route view
features.description: The route view displays the current planned path separately from confirmed position and updates when a route is replanned or cancelled.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic navigation state fixture must show the route endpoints and confirmed location separately; cancellation removes the stale path. Keep visual or text snapshot.

features.title: Equipment view
features.description: Equipment view maps confirmed equipped item IDs to slots and distinguishes pending changes from server-confirmed changes.
acceptanceCriteria: A fixed equipment state must render slot/item pairs and pending markers; a rejected equip restores the confirmed display. Preserve snapshot.

features.title: Skills view
features.description: Skills view lists learned levels and current cooldown/availability from server state and distinguishes unavailable metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: A skill fixture must render exact learned skills and cooldown boundary; unknown IDs remain labeled unknown without guessed descriptions. Keep snapshot.

features.title: Dialogue view
features.description: Dialogue view presents the current server prompt and valid choices, disabling stale choices after the prompt changes or closes.
acceptanceCriteria: Protocol UI fixtures must update choices on each prompt and reject clicks against stale prompt IDs; preserve interaction trace.

features.title: Session management
features.description: Session controls display independent connection stages and allow stopping a session without leaving pending tasks or stale identity visible.
acceptanceCriteria: State-machine UI tests must cover connect, in-game, disconnect, and stop; stopped session clears identity and cancels work. Keep output snapshot and task trace.

features.title: Architecture
features.description: The Rust workspace separates protocol I/O, parsing, world state, decisions, and user interfaces behind explicit contracts, with no dependency cycle between those layers.
acceptanceCriteria: Architecture tests must compile each crate boundary and prove core state/decision modules run without network, UI, or filesystem adapters; preserve dependency graph and test output.

features.title: Licensing
features.description: Every distributed RustKore component, dependency, and bundled data file has a reviewed license and attribution record compatible with the chosen project license.
acceptanceCriteria: A license audit artifact must enumerate direct/transitive dependencies and data sources and identify exceptions; release packaging is blocked by any unresolved incompatible or undocumented license. Keep generated report.

features.title: Benchmark strategy
features.description: Benchmarks define reproducible workloads, correctness checks, toolchain/profile, hardware, warmup, and measurement units before performance claims are published.
acceptanceCriteria: A benchmark protocol fixture must reproduce a baseline and verify correctness assertions; missing environment metadata makes results ineligible for comparison. Preserve command and metadata.

features.title: Test infrastructure
features.description: The test harness runs pure unit tests and deterministic protocol/field fixtures without requiring an external game server or credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: CI must execute representative parser, routing, state, and scheduler fixtures offline and fail on an intentionally mismatched expected result; retain command output.

features.title: Rust workspace
features.description: The repository builds as a minimal Rust workspace with declared members and shared dependency policy, and an empty member can be tested independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Run workspace metadata and package tests in a clean checkout; undeclared paths or an invalid member must fail before application tests. Preserve Cargo metadata output.

features.title: CI
features.description: Continuous integration runs formatting, lint, and test checks on the declared supported toolchain and reports a failing check against the commit that introduced it.
acceptanceCriteria: A workflow validation must show all required jobs run on a sample pull request and fail when a controlled check fails; keep workflow run evidence.

features.title: Deterministic state
features.description: Given the same ordered input events and configuration, the state reducer produces the same world/session state without reading wall-clock or randomness implicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Replay a fixed event log twice with injected clock/random source and compare canonical state hashes; different seeds/clocks must be explicit inputs. Preserve event log and hashes.

features.title: Data validation
features.description: External config, table, field, packet, and CLI data are validated at boundaries with field-specific errors before entering core state.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed fixtures for each boundary must be rejected with location/context and leave the last valid state intact; retain validation matrix.

features.title: Error handling
features.description: Errors carry operation and recovery classification through public boundaries, and callers can distinguish retryable, user-correctable, and fatal failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Injected failures across parser, transport, task, and storage adapters must map to the expected error class and stop/retry policy; preserve test matrix.

features.title: Session stability
features.description: A session maintains valid transitions under packet bursts, timeouts, disconnects, and reconnects without duplicated identity or leaked active tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Stress a deterministic session event stream with reconnect boundaries and assert invariants after every event; retain state and resource counters.

features.title: Memory behavior
features.description: Actor, event, and log collections have explicit lifecycle bounds or removal rules so stale entities and diagnostics do not grow indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: A long deterministic spawn/remove/log workload must keep retained item counts within declared limits while preserving live entries; record memory/count measurements.

features.title: Latency behavior
features.description: Latency measurements identify queue, network, parsing, and decision stages separately and do not count unconfirmed requests as completed actions.
acceptanceCriteria: A scripted workload must emit stage timestamps and verify duration calculations against injected clock; preserve raw sample metadata and report.

features.title: Recovery
features.description: Recoverable faults return the client to a known state and require fresh confirmation before resuming actions; fatal faults stop automation and retain an actionable diagnostic.
acceptanceCriteria: Fault-injection tests at connect, parse, movement, and task stages must assert cleanup and no stale action after recovery; preserve error and transition trace.

features.title: Long-running automation
features.description: Long-running routines periodically reconcile server state and release completed/expired task resources rather than accumulating duplicate work.
acceptanceCriteria: A simulated multi-hour clock/event test must keep task/resource counts bounded and reconcile status after periodic updates; interruption stops timers. Preserve counters and trace.

features.title: Routine coordination
features.description: Combat, navigation, storage, and commerce routines acquire/release declared action ownership and cannot issue conflicting movement or interaction commands concurrently.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic competing-task schedule must prove one owner per exclusive resource and release on success/error/cancel; keep scheduler trace.

features.title: Cross-platform tests
features.description: The same deterministic core fixtures pass on supported stable Rust targets for Windows, Linux, and macOS, with platform-specific adapters isolated.
acceptanceCriteria: CI matrix evidence must report target/toolchain and test results for each declared OS; a skipped platform job is not counted as passing. Preserve workflow results.

features.title: Multiple sessions
features.description: Independent sessions maintain separate sockets, characters, state, timers, and task queues without cross-session event leakage.
acceptanceCriteria: A two-session simulation must interleave identical actor IDs and prove each snapshot remains isolated; closing one session leaves the other active. Keep two-session trace.

features.title: Comparative regressions
features.description: Correctness/performance baselines are compared only for equivalent workload, toolchain, and environment, with regressions tied to measured data rather than a subjective estimate.
acceptanceCriteria: A paired benchmark run must verify workload hash and environment match and report raw samples plus threshold; unmatched runs are rejected. Preserve baseline and comparison output.

features.title: Documentation
features.description: Stable-scope documentation lists supported platforms, configuration formats, known limitations, and reproducible install/run/test steps that match the release artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean-environment walkthrough must complete install, config validation, fixture test, and documented limitation checks; preserve command transcript and release docs.

features.title: Distribution
features.description: Release archives include the executable, required notices, and supported runtime assets for each declared target and exclude secrets or development-only files.
acceptanceCriteria: Build/package tests must inspect archive contents and run a smoke command on each target; missing notice/asset or included credential fixture fails packaging. Keep artifact manifest and checksums.

features.title: Stable scope validation
features.description: A stable release is allowed only when every accumulated mandatory roadmap requirement is verified with current evidence and optional requirements are excluded from the gate.
acceptanceCriteria: A release-gate test must calculate cumulative mandatory requirements from the catalog and block one missing verification; preserve gate input and output.

features.title: Proven performance
features.description: Performance claims use reproducible benchmark evidence against a named baseline and report workload, compiler, hardware, latency, memory, and uncertainty.
acceptanceCriteria: A release benchmark report must contain raw samples and correctness checks for each claim; absent comparable baseline or metadata prevents a claim. Keep benchmark artifact.
